patterns.note: Asymmetrical grid layouts are used to arrange text blocks and imagery, creating dynamic compositions within sections, often with large areas of negative space.

A dramatic contrast in typography is used, pairing an oversized, elegant serif display font with generous letter spacing for hero titles and branding, against a clean, minimal sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A deep, rich forest green serves as the dominant background and accent color, providing a sophisticated and natural backdrop for white text and subtle lighter green graphic elements.

The initial hero section, featuring large branding text and background imagery, scrolls away to reveal a solid dark green background. As the user scrolls further, a distinct footer-like section with a smaller logo and 'All Projects' link becomes visible at the bottom of the viewport.
Sections are visually distinct through full-bleed background colors or imagery, with content often presented in a sparse, editorial manner, emphasizing visual breathing room.

technique_notes: Full-bleed hero images and background sections are used, often with abstract or natural graphic overlays, to establish a strong visual identity and depth.

Typography is used as a primary design element, with extremely large, decorative serif fonts creating a strong visual impact in hero and branding areas, balanced by understated sans-serif for readability.

Uses GSAP to orchestrate scroll-triggered reveals and transitions, where initial hero content scrolls out of view to transition into a simpler, solid background, eventually revealing a persistent footer-like element with brand and navigation links.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, elegant serif display headings (~5-6x body) with generous letter spacing, contrasting with clean, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: sharp corners throughout, maintaining a crisp and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with significant negative space around elements and between sections, contributing to an editorial and luxurious feel.

standout: The site's standout feature is its bold and artful use of typography, particularly the oversized, decorative serif font for branding and hero elements. This, combined with the deep, natural color palette and abstract botanical graphics, elevates a landscaping service into a high-end design studio, creating a distinctive, editorial, and luxurious brand presence.
